prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photo for a personal gift website. A 38-year-old clean-shaven father with short sandy hair has just released his eight-year-old daughter bicycle saddle as she rides independently for the first time on a broad safe park path. She wears a correctly fitted plain helmet and looks ahead; he jogs closely behind with hands near his body. Capture believable pedalling, wheels and balance in gentle morning daylight, with no traffic. Warm family documentary photography with candid timing and unforced expressions. Wide horizontal 16:9 section composition. Keep all main faces, important hands and the complete action safely inside both central 4:3 and 1.65:1 crops, with natural environmental margins. Invent ordinary fictional people with distinct faces, realistic skin and believable age. Use warm paper, muted terracotta and natural surrounding colours without heavy filtering. Preserve correct anatomy, fingers, limbs and object geometry. One continuous real photograph: no fade, gradient mask, crossfade, compositing or synthetic caption band. No readable words, numbers, logos, watermarks, borders, collages or grids.

Additional anatomy and composition requirements: Show a realistic small two-wheel bicycle in side three-quarter view, with two equal circular wheels, an ordinary connected frame, visible fork, saddle, handlebars, chain and pedals. The eight-year-old girl wears ordinary trousers, a light jacket and a properly fitted plain helmet; both feet contact the pedals and both hands grip the handlebar. Her father jogs a short distance behind with arms bent near his torso, hands no longer touching saddle. Use a more distant wide view with the full bicycle, whole child, father face and important hands compactly inside the central 4:3 and 1.65:1 safe crops. No traffic, spare limbs, extra wheels, impossible chain geometry or arms stretching into the margins.
review: Reviewed wide bicycle scene: helmeted school-age girl rides a physically coherent two-wheel bicycle with both hands on handlebar and feet on opposite pedals; father jogs behind with hands no longer on saddle. Full bicycle, child, father and important hands fit central 4:3/1.65 crops. Safe park path, realistic wheels/frame/chain, no text, fade or spare limbs.
